The slide has been reduced to the minimum possible (4.25") without significantly impairing the legendary reliability of the 5" slide. The frame has been modified with the innovative Ed Brown Bobtail housing which reduces the projecting butt of the mainspring housing without sacrificing the full size frame and magazine capacity. The Bobtail minimizes the print under your jacket when carrying and reduces weight. The functional simplicity has yet to be matched. Unique with the Carry series pistols is the innovative snakeskin treatment. It is a directional pattern, meaning it is smooth to slide your hand up, but bites in for a snug grip the other way where you need it. It's easier on the hands than checkering, and those who handle it can't stop bragging about it. Not to mention it just looks cool! The Kobra Carry is an innovative masterpiece, and a serious tool for those who want something a little different.

products.title: ENERGETIC VOX S SPRSR 762 DT BLK
products.description: The VOX Silencer is the result of extensive engineering, testing, and advanced CNC manufacturing to optimize a high-performance, low-weight, extremely durable centerfire rifle silencer. The patented design combines advanced materials and manufacturing methods to achieve an optimal strength-to-weight ratio. The silencer core is CNC-welded from C300 Maraging nickel-cobalt superalloy. Energetic Armament is the first silencer manufacturer to apply this ultra-strong alloy to a silencer. This aerospace alloy was developed and used by NASA to meet the extreme high-temperature stress requirements of rocket motor casings, offering an incredible strength-to-weight ratio. The VOX features a laser-welded core and a removable front cap. The removable front cap allows for replacement with different front cap options. The front cap includes a replaceable wipe to optimize suppression. The wipe can be replaced as needed, making maintenance and reassembly simple.

The LUX is designed for use on precision bolt-action rifles and for moderate firing schedules on semi-auto rifles. The patented design combines advanced materials and manufacturing methods to produce a lightweight, durable, high-performance silencer. The LUX features a tubeless, fully welded core constructed entirely of Grade 5 titanium. This aerospace alloy provides exceptional strength while maintaining very low weight. The fully welded construction eliminates concerns about loosening baffles and increases structural rigidity.
